visits.noteText: G2P1 at 12w0d by early ultrasound. Prior pregnancy: uncomplicated spontaneous vaginal delivery with labor epidural at Larkspur Regional. No known bleeding disorder; denies easy bruising or heavy menses. No chronic medical conditions. Prenatal panel and CBC sent to Northgate Diagnostic Laboratories. Prenatal vitamin started.

diagnoses.description: Encounter for supervision of other normal pregnancy, first trimester

visits.noteText: 28w visit. Glucose challenge normal. CBC from Northgate: platelets 118 x10^3/uL, below the laboratory reference range (previously 162 at intake). Denies epistaxis, gum bleeding, petechiae. BP 112/70. Plan: repeat CBC at 34 weeks; if platelets continue to decline, refer to hematology.

34w1d. Repeat platelet count 86 x10^3/uL (Northgate). Trend 162 -> 118 -> 86. No petechiae or bruising. BP 118/74, no headache or visual changes, urine protein negative. Assessment: thrombocytopenia in pregnancy, etiology not yet established (gestational thrombocytopenia vs. immune thrombocytopenia under consideration). Plan: hematology referral placed (Larkspur Regional Hematology); repeat CBC with peripheral smear in 2 weeks; induction of labor at 39 weeks scheduled at Larkspur Regional Labor & Delivery. Obstetric anesthesia consultation not yet requested.

visits.chiefComplaint: MFM consultation: pregnancy with prior lymphoma treatment and history of DVT
visits.noteText: 36-year-old G1P0 at 14w. History of Hodgkin lymphoma (2016, Cedar Hollow oncology) treated with ABVD chemotherapy and mediastinal radiation, in remission. Left leg DVT in 2019 (Cedar Hollow ED), completed anticoagulation. Plan: prophylactic enoxaparin 40 mg daily through pregnancy and postpartum; cardiology (cardio-oncology) referral for baseline echocardiogram given anthracycline and chest radiation exposure; oncology survivorship records requested from Cedar Hollow.

32w. Repeat echocardiogram reviewed with cardiology: LVEF 43-45%, stable. Mild exertional fatigue, no orthopnea. Continues enoxaparin 40 mg daily. Delivery plan: cesarean delivery at 37w0d scheduled at Larkspur Regional. Timing of the last enoxaparin dose relative to delivery to be coordinated. Multidisciplinary planning discussion with cardiology and obstetric anesthesia recommended before delivery; not yet scheduled.
G1P0 at 9w2d. No significant medical history. No prior surgeries or anesthesia. Prenatal panel sent to Northgate. Prenatal vitamin started. Routine prenatal care plan reviewed.

diagnoses.description: Encounter for supervision of normal first pregnancy, first trimester

visits.noteText: 24w. Fetal anatomy survey normal. BP 108/66. CBC within reference ranges. No concerns.

34w. Normal growth. BP 112/70. Labs within reference ranges. Birth preferences discussed: patient interested in labor epidural. Plan: weekly visits from 36 weeks; spontaneous labor anticipated, tentative induction slot at 41 weeks booked at Larkspur Regional.

G2P1 at 13w. Prior delivery at Cedar Hollow Community Hospital: urgent cesarean delivery (details per patient; outside records requested). Adolescent scoliosis surgery (spinal fusion) as a teenager. Plan: repeat cesarean delivery at 39 weeks at Larkspur Regional; obtain Cedar Hollow delivery and anesthesia records.

diagnoses.description: Maternal care for low transverse scar from previous cesarean delivery

visits.noteText: 32w. Doing well. BP 116/72. Repeat cesarean scheduled at Larkspur Regional at 39 weeks. Cedar Hollow records received and filed in chart; not yet reviewed with anesthesia.
